Figure_2.jpg.caption: Representative histological images and quantitative analyses of cardiac tissue from the experimental groups. H&E stained sections (A–C), Masson's trichrome stained sections (D–F), scale bar: 100 µm. (→): cardiomyocytes, (*): fibrotic areas. A and D: Control group, B and E: Isoproterenol group, C and F: Isoproterenol+Polydatin group. Quantitative analyses of interventricular septal thickness (G), left ventricular posterior wall thickness (H), and interstitial fibrosis percentage (I) are shown. Data are presented as mean ± SEM (n=6 per group). Statistical comparisons were performed using one-way ANOVA followed by Bonferroni-corrected post hoc comparisons. *p<0.001 vs. control group; #p<0.001 vs. isoproterenol group.
